About Glen Group 
 Glen Group is a dynamic and fast-growing organization dedicated to providing high-quality services across multiple industries, including traffic control, security, construction, and management. With a strong foundation built on integrity, innovation, and service excellence, we are committed to delivering value to our clients and fostering growth within our teams.
 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 
 At Glen Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and inclusion builds stronger teams. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to thrive—regardless of race, gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or background. We actively promote equity, fairness, and opportunity in every aspect of our hiring, operations, and company culture.
 Key Responsibilities: 

• Develop and maintain strong visual branding across all platforms

• Understand and follow brand guidelines to ensure consistency in all designs

• Create high-quality designs for social media, marketing materials, and digital platforms

• Design user-friendly and visually engaging UI/UX for websites and digital products

• Create motion graphics, video editing and assist with video content as required

• Design and prepare print-ready files for materials such as catalogs, brochures, and other marketing collateral

• Select and apply appropriate typography, colors, layouts, and imagery

• Collaborate closely with the team to understand requirements and deliver creative solutions

• Manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

• Design and format professional documents in PowerPoint and Word as per team requirements

 Requirements: 

• Proven experience as a Senior Graphic Designer or UI/UX Designer

• Strong understanding of branding, layout design, and user experience principles

• Ability to create unique, clean, and modern designs without relying heavily on references

• Experience in social media design, digital content, and visual storytelling

• Strong knowledge of print design and production (catalogs, brochures, and other printed materials)

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, In Design and After Effects, Figma, and Canva (essential)

• Ability to design professional layouts in PowerPoint and Word 

• Strong attention to detail, creativity, and time management skills

• Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively within a team

 What We Are Looking For: 

• Someone who understands design beyond just visuals

• Ability to think creatively and produce original work

• Strong sense of responsibility and ownership of projects

• A team player who can collaborate effectively

 Salary: 6PLA - 10.80LPA
 Originally posted on Himalayas
